description: Look up a dental provider by NPI. With a Bearer token (ps_live_*), returns the full record: taxonomy, practice address, license status, DSO affiliation, OIG-exclusion, and a 0-100 confidence score. Without auth, falls back to the free tier (100/day/IP) which returns light data only — name, primary practice address, taxonomy, and enumeration date. Sources: NPPES + 42 state dental boards + DC + CMS Medicare Part B.
name: lookup_provider_by_npi
